processSection.heading: How it works
processSection.subtitle: Four steps, no shoot day, and nothing goes out without your yes.

steps.title: Your brand kit (once)
steps.description: You send your logo, colours, product photos and the offer to push. We set it up once and reuse it every time.

steps.title: Script and hooks (a day or two)
steps.description: We write the script and two or three openings. You approve them before anything is made.

steps.title: We make and edit (a few days)
steps.description: AI creates the visuals and voice, then we edit by hand: pacing, captions, your logo and licensed music.

steps.title: You approve and post
steps.description: We fix anything you flag, then send files sized for every platform.

faqSection.heading: Common questions
faqSection.subtitle: What people ask before buying AI video.

faqs.question: Do you film anything?
faqs.answer: No. No shoot, camera, crew or location. Everything is made with AI and edited by hand, which is why it costs a fraction of a shoot and arrives in days.

faqs.question: Will it look fake?
faqs.answer: Some AI video does. Ours doesn't go out until it looks right. We keep shots short, use your real product photos, and replace anything that looks odd. You see everything first.

faqs.question: Do you use my real products and branding?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your logo, colours and product photos once, and every video uses them.

faqs.question: Can you put me or my staff in the videos?
faqs.answer: Only with written permission, using a short consent form. Otherwise we use licensed AI presenters.

faqs.question: How many changes, and how fast?
faqs.answer: Two rounds of changes on every video. A 3-reel pack takes about five working days. Monthly plans follow a calendar you approve at the start of the month.

faqs.question: Who owns the videos? Can I run them as ads?
faqs.answer: You do, once the invoice is paid, including for ads. Music and presenters are licensed for business use.

faqs.question: Can you handle a large volume?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monthly plans go up to 10 videos and 30 posts a month, planned a month ahead. Bigger campaigns are quoted.
